title: BillingCashoutDecision
description: billing.cashout-decision@1: bodies of billing.cashout.manage on OpenVibe.Billing (staff). POST /api/v1/cashouts/:id/approve: { payout_reference, payout_provider? } after the payout was sent (payout_provider defaults to paypal; refused while the cashout is in escrow). POST /api/v1/cashouts/:id/deny: { reason? } returns the bits to the person's payable. GET /api/v1/cashouts takes no body. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key header (a replay with the same key and body returns the first answer) and is refused with 503 billing.frozen while the economy is frozen. Refusals are problem+json (billing.invalid_input, billing.invalid_amount, billing.insufficient_funds, …).
